description.zh: 东京迪士尼度假区由东京迪士尼乐园（1983年开园，亚洲第一座迪士尼主题乐园）和东京迪士尼海洋（2001年开园，全球唯一以海洋探险为主题的迪士尼乐园）组成，位于千叶县浦安市，乘JR从东京站仅需约15分钟。
description.en: Tokyo Disney Resort comprises Tokyo Disneyland (opened 1983, Asia's first Disney theme park) and Tokyo DisneySea (opened 2001, the world's only ocean-themed Disney park). Located in Urayasu, Chiba, it is just ~15 minutes by JR from Tokyo Station.

zh: 东京迪士尼乐园：经典城堡区、幻想乐园、探险乐园等七大主题区域，含多个超人气表演
东京迪士尼海洋：以神秘岛、美国海滨等7个主题港口为场景，是全球公认最美的迪士尼乐园之一
Fantasy Springs（2024年新开园区）：冰雪奇缘、小飞侠、魔发奇缘三主题港口
en: Tokyo Disneyland: seven themed lands including Fantasyland and Adventureland, with multiple headline shows
Tokyo DisneySea: seven themed ports including Mysterious Island and American Waterfront — widely rated the most beautiful Disney park in the world
Fantasy Springs (opened 2024): Frozen, Peter Pan and Rapunzel themed port areas

admission.zh: 1日票约9,400—10,900日元（节假日较贵），建议在线选购时间段入园票
admission.en: One-day ticket ~¥9,400–10,900 (higher on peak days); online timed-entry tickets recommended

duration.zh: 全天（两个乐园各建议安排一天）
duration.en: Full day per park (one day each recommended)

tips.zh: 人气设施需使用Disney Premier Access（付费优先通行）或提前在官方App上抢到优先入场号。强烈建议在官方App上提前规划一日行程。
tips.en: For top rides use Disney Premier Access (paid fast pass) or grab standby times early via the official app. Plan your full day in the app before arriving.
